title: Multi-Level Drainage Exchange Aggregation and Branch-Composition Structural Candidate

legacy_semantics.scope: DRAMET=3 multi-level exchange aggregation after each level response has been evaluated
legacy_semantics.level_loop: legacy drainage.f90 evaluates lev=1..nrlevs and later drainage_basic accumulates qdrtot by qdrtot=qdrtot+qdrain(level) in level order
legacy_semantics.shared_hydraulic_summary: all DRAMET=3 levels use the same groundwater-level summary for a calculation point
legacy_semantics.per_level_controls: drain head and allow-direction semantics are level-specific
legacy_semantics.highest_level_special_case: empirical interflow selection for lev==nrlevs is response-law composition upstream of this aggregator, not aggregation logic
legacy_semantics.legacy_capacity: MADR is a compile-time array capacity, not a physical invariant and is not propagated into the modern contract

modern_contract.input: ordered assumed-shape array of already-evaluated drainage_level_exchange_t records
modern_contract.level_identity: input record level_index must equal its one-based array position; ordering is physical drainage-level order
modern_contract.flux_semantics: signed_soil_to_drain_rate > 0 leaves soil; < 0 enters soil; aggregation itself is sign-agnostic
modern_contract.total_flux: deterministic sequential level-order sum of the authoritative per-level rates
modern_contract.derivative: aggregate dq/dgwl is published only when every level derivative is defined and finite; otherwise aggregate derivative is unavailable while the valid flux sum is preserved
modern_contract.branch_composition: branch-boundary and singular-tangent diagnostics are unioned conservatively across levels
modern_contract.nonsmooth_cancellation: never inferred; if any level derivative is unavailable, the aggregate derivative remains unavailable unless a future separately qualified proof supplies stronger information
modern_contract.allocation: no heap allocation required by aggregation hot path
modern_contract.level_count: dynamic; no legacy MADR=5/25 limit in the kernel contract

mass_and_transaction_contract.aggregate_total: derived view of exactly those transfers, never an additional transfer
mass_and_transaction_contract.double_booking: forbidden: a committed ledger may book constituent levels or their total representation according to its schema, but must not count both as separate water transfers
mass_and_transaction_contract.invalid_level: fails closed; an invalid or nonfinite constituent may not be silently skipped
mass_and_transaction_contract.tangent_unavailable: must not invalidate or zero an otherwise valid physical flux sum
mass_and_transaction_contract.rejected_trial: aggregation is pure and creates no committed mutation or ledger booking

ownership.response_law_owner: evaluates each level physics and derivative metadata before aggregation
ownership.aggregator_owner: preserves level identity, forms total transfer view and composes derivative/branch availability
ownership.solver_owner: residual/Jacobian assembly and any chain rule to solver unknowns
ownership.runtime_coupler_owner: accepted-transfer ledger publication, rollback/commit, receiver wiring and interval composition

required_tests: two-level and multi-level deterministic signed flux summation
mixed positive/negative constituent support without claiming negative-branch physics qualification
one or more unavailable derivatives preserve total flux and make aggregate derivative unavailable
branch-boundary and singular-tangent diagnostics compose as a union/count
invalid or nonfinite constituent fails closed and is never skipped
dynamic level counts including counts above legacy MultiSWAP and standalone MADR capacities
no I/O, calendar, MODFLOW topology, HeadCalc, solver Jacobian, DIVDRA or persistent-state leakage
hard_holds: No response-law dispatch or highest-level interflow selection inside the aggregator.
No qualification of negative-side DRAMET=3 infiltration physics merely because signed negative inputs can be aggregated.
No DIVDRA/node-distribution work; F-PM08B owns spatial distribution.
No surface-water storage/control; F-PM08D owns that component.
No runtime ledger implementation or canonical admission.
No solver Jacobian mutation or process-side fallback/smoothing.
No fixed MADR limit in modern kernel code.
